description: A type that references itself, e.g. `type JsonValue = ... | JsonValue[]`. Direct self-reference in aliases works since TypeScript 3.7.
TypeScript 4.1+: a conditional type that calls itself in a branch, used as a type-level loop.
The branch that stops the recursion, usually the false branch of the conditional type.
TypeScript 4.5+ evaluates conditional types whose branch is exactly the recursive call in a loop, allowing up to 1000 iterations.
An extra type parameter with a default (`Acc extends unknown[] = []`) that carries the partial result, enabling tail recursion.
